messages:
ashwin: quick ping — prepping catalog launch smoke tomorrow. who is the final owner for license signoff on the two new open models (navis-lite, ozark3b)? need green before we flip routing.

maria: @ashwin I can take legal coordination for navis-lite. i still need the curated attribution file from curation. can @sophia attach? :+1:

sophia: attaching now — small tweak in dataset source field. added in our drive: https://internal.redwood/curation/navis-lite/attribution_v2.csv

ashwin: perfect thx. and ozark3b?

devin: i'm on ozark3b perf profile. ran a quick latency sweep on p2.xlarge and p4d samples this morning. baseline looks ok but we have tokenization mismatch for some inputs.

devin: sample perf snippet:```json
{
  "model": "ozark3b",
  "p95_ms": 142,
  "p50_ms": 64,
  "tokenization_mismatch_pct": 3.2
}
```

ashwin: mismatch 3.2% — do you think that's quantization or tokenizer model artifact?

devin: leaning tokenizer. me + infra will run a quick compare with hf-tokenizers before changing quant profiles.

maria: legal note — ozark3b has a downstream-use restriction clause. we need product to confirm no prohibited use. @ashwin can you confirm product ok?

ashwin: cc @sophia — product constraints are fine for the catalog surface we have (no high-risk labels).

sophia: confirmed. product ok for catalog listing w/ the restriction note. will add to metadata.

kevin-legal-bot: REMINDER — add license_text and license_url to model manifest or onboarding will be blocked by the catalog gate. (automated)

ashwin: action items so far:
1) maria: finalize license signoff for navis-lite (attach final doc)
2) kevin-legal-bot / legal: confirm ozark3b restriction note copy
3) devin + eng-infra: run tokenizer compare + post new perf artifact by EOD
4) sophia: add license/license_url + restriction field to model manifest and push to registry

ops-bot: deploy-checklist reminder — canary window available 09:30-11:30 PT tomorrow.

ashwin: ok schedule: if all items green by EOD, target canary in morning window. if any license hold, we delay.

sophia: i updated manifest: added `license_text`, `license_url`, and `usage_restrictions` fields in registry entry for both models. pushed at 176880 + 45s.

devin: tokenizer compare running now, will post diff + new perf JSON in this thread.

maria: uploaded navis-lite license doc to legal drive and left comments for one line change. will finish signoff after that.

ashwin: thanks everyone — ping in thread asap with final green. i'll coordinate canary with ops. :rocket:
